behaviors.behavior: AC1 — branch/Stop audit presents Group-E pending-release drift locally and never mutates the global backlog
AC2 — branch/Stop audit with a real non-E failure also stays local, backlog unmutated
AC3 — merge authority reads the delivered PR's exact mergeCommit and audits it in a detached worktree, converging A-D/F-I only on complete coverage
AC4 — merge coverage records E as not_applicable+complete; a genuinely missing/crashed/wrong-commit group is missing and leaves the backlog untouched
AC5 — a verified release commit runs full A-I authority and may refresh/dismiss Group E and every other group
AC6 — the 5-to-13-to-5 Group-E branch-noise regression cannot mutate the global backlog; branch diagnostics stay visible
AC7 — docs/hooks-and-pipeline.md accurately maps Stop/branch feedback, delivery/merge authority, and release authority; derived snapshots remain release-owned
behaviors.evidence: Manual diff review of docs/hooks-and-pipeline.md against the shipped code at F5 time: the new 'Compliance backlog lifecycle authority' section and the two Stop-hook table rows were cross-checked line-by-line against audit_compliance_on_stop.py (no mirror_findings_to_triage call — branch feedback only) and refresh_compliance_docs.py (--release-audit flag confirmed present, requires --verify-commit).
